purpose: Demonstrate that static Nordtvedt signals are absorbed by standard fitting, but dynamically modulated TEP signals are not

static_signal.interpretation: Static signal is well-recovered by standard fitting

tep_signal.interpretation: Dynamic signal is not fully absorbed - sidebands remain in residuals

null_case.interpretation: Noise-only case shows no spurious detection

conclusion.key_finding: Static Nordtvedt signals are absorbed with 103.3% efficiency by standard ephemeris fitting, while dynamically modulated TEP signals leave 0.1% of power in sideband frequencies that are spectrally orthogonal to standard integrators. This validates the ephemeris absorption argument.
